clusters.name: ai-developer-toolkit-changelog-and-headers
clusters.executionModeRationale: US-001 (CHANGELOG promotion) and US-002 (header comments) both touch ai-developer-toolkit only and have no file overlap. US-002 cites the CHANGELOG anchor produced by US-001, so US-001 should commit first inside the same topic branch; a single impl member should own both.

clusters.name: codexu-audit-and-followups
clusters.executionModeRationale: US-003 produces the audit report; US-004 produces the follow-up backlog. Both are new files in the same codexu job dir; no file overlap; a single impl member can drive both. No dependency on Cluster 1 — the audit report cites the CHANGELOG by path so the two repo PRs can land in either order.
